### Accepted requirements

The authoritative [REQ-01 through REQ-18](../../solution-whiteboard.md#6-needs-and-candidate-requirements)
are incorporated by reference without abbreviation of their acceptance criteria.
They cover batched preparation/questions/corrections, retained independent
review, PR-primary evidence, honest same-account attribution, table-default
human briefs, draft-first discovery, all lifecycle phases, recovery and
measurement without weaker controls.

### Accepted solution

Use dependency-aware provisional packages for adoption and planning; one planned
full two-agent review per coherent PR during implementation; one combined
closure review followed by authorized verified mechanics. Consolidate revisions
with the same reviewers. Human decisions and exact acceptance remain distinct
from technical checks. The coordinator publishes labeled reviewer findings on
the actual PR using the existing account; no formal self-approval is claimed.

### Candidate system contracts to formalize

Formalize PG-01 cadence and provisional dependencies, PG-02 PR-primary retention,
PG-03 draft-to-conclusion, PG-04 bounded recovery, and the table brief in their
existing canonical owners. The [control audit](control-audit.md) enumerates affected clauses and every
existing checker diagnostic. [BC01-BC08](design-contracts.md) specify proposed
versioning, recovery and publication contracts for joint acceptance.

### Required delivery boundaries

Keep policy, schema semantics, consumers, tests and migration guidance coherent.
Do not silently migrate old documents or update the installed pin. No task
starts from this draft. Quality, semantic approval, WIP, branch isolation,
merge authority and safe cleanup remain required.

### Required evidence

Full documentation gates and changed-boundary positive/negative fixtures;
exact-revision review; authorized live PR inline-publication demonstration;
failure and recovery traces; honest comparative effort record. Mock responses
do not prove live authentication or callback/publication success.

### Deferred work and residual risk

Runtime issues 33, 34 and 36 remain owner-tracked separate work. GitHub Apps,
new credentials and hosted services remain deferred in issue 38. Preserve
historical evidence. Unavailable or changed PR evidence must stop acceptance;
lower session counts alone do not demonstrate better quality or elapsed time.

## 3. Review and trigger

The combined package must be complete, exact-version bound and self-reviewed,
then reviewed by exactly two isolated retained reviewers and accepted by the
owner. The joint session record will carry exact receipts; this handoff is not approved. No approved handoff version,
trigger timestamp or consumption event exists. On acceptance, reconcile
dependencies and record the exactly-once trigger before implementation routing.
